network_partial_har_hint: Export a minimized partial HAR; wall-clock timestamps and raw content are unavailable
network_search: Method, status or entry · Enter to apply
network_export_scope: Save exports the whole minimized session; Copy exports the published page
network_source_changed: The HAR changed. Import it again; the previous page is retained.
network_invalid_query: The query is invalid or unsupported by this source. Search is limited to 128 UTF-8 bytes and minimized fields; transport-outcome filters require observed Agent evidence.
network_import_failed: Cannot import or query this HAR. Check its format and import limits.
network_coverage: HAR import · minimized evidence · live capture and event completeness are not established
network_activity_unavailable: Activity timeline unavailable: request timestamps are not retained by the minimized adapter. Durations are source-provided, not measured device intervals.
network_domains_unavailable: Domain aggregation unavailable: URLs and hosts are removed by the minimization policy. No domain names are inferred from redacted URLs.
network_empty: Import a local HAR to inspect minimized request evidence.
network_outcome_unknown: Call outcome is not retained; HTTP errors are not call failures
network_coverage_unknown: HAR does not establish capture coverage or event loss
network_content_excluded: Excluded by the minimization policy; no raw content is stored, exported or sent to AI.
network_live_unavailable_reason: Live Android network capture needs a Rust Agent adapter; importing HAR does not start device capture.
network_har_unavailable_reason: HAR export is unavailable: the minimized adapter does not retain the fields needed for a trustworthy HAR.
network_raw_unavailable_reason: Raw bundles are not retained or exported by the minimization policy.
network_activity_legend: Activity requires observed request intervals. Source HAR durations alone do not establish a shared device clock or a throughput timeline.
network_live_confirm: Connect to {package} (PID {pid}) on {serial}. Captures only instrumented OkHttp clients; raw URLs, headers, cookies and bodies are not retained.
network_live_select_target: Select an online device and a running app process in the title bar.
network_live_coverage: APS Network Agent · instrumented OkHttp only · WebView, Cronet, URLConnection, native sockets and unconfigured clients excluded
network_live_cancelled: Capture cancelled; previous published evidence retained.
network_live_body_bytes_note: Observed body-end bytes only; not full wire traffic.
network_live_counts: Events {events} · dropped {dropped} · sequence gaps {gaps} · incomplete calls {incomplete}
network_live_snapshot_digest: Minimized snapshot SHA-256 {digest}; not a digest of the original stream.
network_live_activity: Device monotonic interval {duration} · active {active} · completed {completed} · failed {failed} · cancelled {cancelled}
network_live_phase_partial: Missing phase endpoints remain unknown; retries are listed separately.
network_live_no_content: Raw URL, headers, cookies, body, TLS/cipher and free-form diagnostics are not retained.
network_live_snapshot_evidence_note: SHA-256 identifies the minimized immutable snapshot, not the original Agent stream. Raw URL, headers, cookies, body, TLS/cipher and free-form diagnostics are not retained.
network_live_capture_limits: Limits: 30 minutes, 200,000 events, 20,000 calls; stop drain is bounded.
network_live_limit_reached: Capture budget reached; evidence is bounded and incomplete.
